definitions: A short high-pitched humming sound, such as that made by a bullet or vibrating string.
A witty insult or derogatory remark.
To move very quickly, especially while making a high-pitched hum.
To address a witty insult or comeback to.

blocks.text: Zing! is an American barbershop quartet, which won the Sweet Adelines International Quartet Championship for 2010 in October 2009 in Nashville, Tennessee. Sweet Adelines, "one of the world's largest singing organizations for women", has members over five continents who belong to more than 1200 quartets. The State Library of Kansas, representing the quartet's home state, lists Zing! among its "Musicians of Note". Zing! announced its retirement in November 2012.
